description: f16 [2, 1024]: f16 values near 1000: the sums (~1e6) overflow to inf.
reference: torch.sum(x, dim, keepdim) in f64, rounded once to f16
notes: Expected NaN must be NaN (any NaN matches any NaN) and expected ±inf must be the same inf. out is computed in f64 from the inputs and rounded once to the dtype under test; torch in the dtype itself meets the tolerance (checked by the generator). f16/bf16 accumulate in f32 (graph-ir.md §3.1.8).
